set.body:
Purpose

Establish one source of truth from public request through execution receipt and make geometry query-first.

Surface

Introduce a clear plan constructor such as plan_geometry(). Queries execute that plan. geometry(plan) is explicit materialization; any compatibility call geometry(relation, ...) must compile and execute the same plan.

Acceptance

- Numerical kernels receive only canonical compiled objects.
- Plan identity records scientific semantics; execution receipt records the actual lowering, blocks, cache behavior, and materialization.
- Identity/native-diagonal metrics select the additive feature-collapse lowering.
- Non-diagonal local metrics select a support-streamed lowering and never materialize pair atoms or pair-frame weights.
- Contrast/RDM/RSA queries execute only required coordinates; complete geometry is size-preflighted and explicit.
- Query-first and full materialization agree on small fixtures.
- Redundant contraction routes survive only if a benchmark proves a distinct winning regime.
- Hot-loop object-size counters are replaced by static owned-buffer planning plus coarse execution observations.
set.title: Epic 4: Make the evidence plan the only executable geometry path
